func parseForm(name string) (*norm.Form, error) {
	switch name {
	case "":
		return nil, nil
	case "nfc":
		f := norm.NFC
		return &f, nil
	case "nfd":
		f := norm.NFD
		return &f, nil
	case "nfkc":
		f := norm.NFKC
		return &f, nil
	case "nfkd":
		f := norm.NFKD
		return &f, nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown normalization form %q", name)
	}
}
